name: LOLA
summary: A tall, lightweight biped from TU Munich's Chair of Applied Mechanics, built to push fast, robust walking. LOLA has toe joints and a stiff, low-inertia lightweight structure, and has demonstrated stable walking above 3 km/h with real-time vision-based foothold planning on uneven ground.
notable: Among the fastest-walking full-size bipeds of its generation
Active toe joints for a more human push-off
